subject: "micro" object in temporary environment not found and ectotherm with lapply or foreach not running

messages.author: be6237e3822531de
messages.subject: "micro" object in temporary environment not found and ectotherm with lapply or foreach not running
parts:
Hi everyone, 

I've created microclimate models, and they are stored on my local disk. I'm now running the ecto models, and for this I use future_lapply. However, when I try to call the micro objects from temporary environments, the objects are not found. But I'm 100% sure they are there since they appear when I call them individually. Likewise, if I call them from the .GlobalEnv environment they work but due to memory issues and always being in the global environment the nodes crashed and run a certain number of models, very few. I attached a simple code of what happens and the error that appears. I also can't run the ecotherm models in plan(sequential) with lapply or with parallelization with foreach because the program stops and crashes and an error appears (I've attached an image) "At line 401 of file ECTOTHERM.f Fortran runtime error: Attempting to allocate already allocated variable 'pond_env'". I have tried this on multiple computers and always get the same error (same with micro objects created and saved on local disk).

# List of .rda files
file_list <- list.files("path//folder", pattern = "\\.rda$", full.names = TRUE)

# Simplified function to load and check for the 'micro' object
check_micro <- function(file_path) {
  # Create a temporary environment
  # Load the .rda file into the temporary environment
  temp_env <- new.env()
  load(file_path, envir = temp_env)
  micro <- temp_env$micro
  ectotherm()
 
}

# Apply the function to the list of files
results <- future_lapply(file_list, check_micro)

Maybe someone has already been through this???

Thanks!

Carolina

messages.author: 6cec8ea3702ece93
messages.subject: Re: "micro" object in temporary environment not found and ectotherm with lapply or foreach not running
parts:
Hi Carolina,
Did you try:
micro <<- temp_env$micro
in your code? Note the double < which brings it into the global environment. But this could be dangerous if you're doing things in parallel.
All the best,
Mike

messages.subject: Re: "micro" object in temporary environment not found and ectotherm with lapply or foreach not running
parts:
Hi Carolina,

I just ran the code below and it worked.

Can you try it and then reinstall the latest version of NicheMapR on github and try again? I haven't changed anything specifically in the ectotherm model but did fix an uninitialised variable in the microclimate model that someone else noticed was causing memory issues in some situations.

library(NicheMapR)
for(i in 1:5){
  micro <- micro_global(runshade = 0)
  save(micro, file = paste0('micro', i, '.rda'))

# Simplified function to load and check for the 'micro' object
check_micro <- function(file_path) {
  # Create a temporary environment
  # Load the .rda file into the temporary environment
  temp_env <- new.env()
  load(file_path, envir = temp_env)
  micro <- temp_env$micro
  ectotherm()
 
}

# Apply the function to the list of files
